answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 89 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a horizon bet on surviving 89 epochs of grading, and every whisper settlement recomputes the haven schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
